Action.DeployHint: Place tokens for the squad on the current scene
Action.RecallHint: Remove the squad's tokens from the current scene
Action.CombatHint: Add the squad's tokens on this scene to the encounter
Action.FullRepairHint: Run Lancer's Full Repair for every member (pilots and their mechs)
Action.LicenseHint: Raise every member pilot's License Level by one
Action.RosterHint: Post the squad and mech status to chat
Action.LicenseDownHint: Lower every member pilot's License Level by one (minimum 0)

Member.RemoveBody: Remove {name} from {party}? The actor itself is not deleted.
Member.LinkBroken: This mech's pilot field doesn't point back to this pilot. Lancer won't pass the pilot's bonuses to it until the link is fixed on the mech sheet.
Member.DropHint: Drag pilots, mechs or NPC allies here. A mech with a pilot adds its pilot. Drag a member onto another to reorder.
Member.MissingNotice: Some members no longer exist (their actors were deleted).

Mission.Label: Mission
Mission.Name: Mission
Mission.SitrepHint: Mission type, e.g. Control, Escort, Extraction, Holdout, Recon

Reserves.None: No shared reserves. Drop Lancer items here (reserves, gear…) to pool them.
Reserves.DropHint: Drop items here. Items dragged from a sheet you own are moved; items from the sidebar or compendiums are copied.
Reserves.Name: Name
Reserves.NoTargets: You don't own any pilot in this party.
Reserves.DeleteBody: Delete this reserve from the party stash?

Check.GroupHase: Mech skills (rolled by the mech, or the pilot if unmounted)
Check.SkillHint: Pilots without the chosen trigger roll a plain d20, as in the core rules. Each player gets Lancer's accuracy/difficulty dialog.

FullRepair.Title: Full Repair: squad
FullRepair.Warning: This is Lancer's own Full Repair: HP, heat, structure, stress, repairs and core power are restored, statuses are cleared and unequipped items are removed from the actor.

License.Title: Award License Level
License.Body: Raise the License Level of every pilot in the party by 1 (maximum 12)? Players then pick their new license, talent or skill on their pilot sheet.
License.DownBody: Lower the License Level of every pilot in the party by 1 (minimum 0)? Players should remove the license, talent or skill they gained at that level on their pilot sheet.

EndMission.Title: End mission
EndMission.Log: Add the mission to the log
EndMission.Advance: Start the next mission (number +1, clear name, SITREP and briefing)
EndMission.ChatRepaired: The squad performed a Full Repair.
EndMission.ChatLicense: Every pilot gained a License Level.

Deploy.Title: Deploy squad
Deploy.Body: Place tokens for members who aren't on this scene yet, around the party token or the centre of the view.
Deploy.ModeAuto: Mechs, or pilots without a mech
Deploy.NoPartyToken: Tip: put the party token on the map to choose where the squad deploys.
Deploy.NothingToDeploy: Everyone is already on this scene.
Deploy.NoRoom: Some tokens didn't fit on the scene.

Recall.Title: Recall squad
Recall.Body: Remove {count} squad token(s) from this scene?
Recall.PlaceParty: Put the party token where the squad was
Recall.Nothing: No squad tokens on this scene.

Combat.NoTokens: No squad tokens on this scene that aren't already in combat.
Combat.NoEncounter: There is no encounter for this scene. Ask the GM to create one.

Notify.MechRedirected: {mech} is piloted by {pilot}; {pilot} joins the party and the mech is shown under them.
Notify.NotAdded: {count} actor(s) can't join a party (only world pilots, mechs and NPCs can).

HideMembers.Name: Hide party members elsewhere in the Actors tab
HideMembers.Hint: Members (and, if shown, their mechs) appear only inside their party at the top of the Actors tab, like PF2e. Turn off to keep them in their folders as well.

ShowMechs.Name: Show pilots' mechs in the sidebar
ShowMechs.Hint: List each pilot's active mech under the pilot in the party entry.

StatsVisibility.Name: Who sees squad stats
StatsVisibility.Hint: Whether players see HP, heat, structure and other stats of squadmates they don't have Observer permission for.
StatsVisibility.Observer: Only users with Observer permission on that actor

MemberEditing.Name: Players can update party tracking
MemberEditing.Hint: Players who own a member can tick clocks, check objectives and manage shared reserves and manna. Their changes are applied by the GM's client, so a GM must be connected.

DefaultOwnership.Name: Default player access to new parties
DefaultOwnership.Hint: Ownership level given to all players when a party is created.

AutoCreate.Name: Create a party in new worlds
AutoCreate.Hint: When the world has no party yet, the GM's client creates one on load and makes it active.

Error.Generic: Something went wrong. See the console (F12) for details.
Error.NoGM: A GM must be connected to apply this change.
Error.NotOwner: You don't have permission to change this party.
Error.GMOnly: Only the GM can do this.
Error.MemberMissing: That party member no longer exists.
Error.ResultNotSaved: The roll result couldn't be added to the card.
Error.NothingToRepair: There's nothing you can repair in this party.
Error.OldLancer: Lancer Party needs Lancer {min} or newer (installed: {version}). Some features may not work.

Op.denied: You don't have permission to do that.

Side.MechsTip: Mechs and NPC allies in the field
Side.DamagedTip: Mechs that have lost HP or structure
